summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes a 727KB obfuscated payload
details: @onereach/slack-helpers@1.0.5 declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun (release v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it on the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob (string-array rotator, hex-mangled identifiers) shipped at the tarball root; it is not referenced from `dist/index.js` (the declared `main`) and has no relationship to the package's stated Slack-helper purpose. The obfuscated payload runs automatically on `npm install` under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime, bypassing Node-based inspection, and executes opaque code with the installer's privileges before any code path in the documented library is reached.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
